about.name: DAVID SÁNCHEZ
about.info:
Software developer and database support professional with experience in corporate Java applications in the renewable energy sector.

I work on the development and maintenance of AIRe (Iberdrola Renewables' Application for Stations), a platform for the comprehensive management of weather stations and measurement equipment, including data loading and the calculation of availability and quality indicators for Iberdrola's Renewables area.

items.name: Java Developer & Oracle Database Support
items.info:
Carbajosa de la Sagrada, Salamanca | Spain

Development and maintenance of a corporate application for the integral management of meteorological stations in Iberdrola's Renewable area, participating in the full development cycle: backend, persistence, REST APIs, testing, automation, documentation, and deployment.

Responsibilities and key contributions:

- Development and evolution of backend functionality in Java, working on a corporate application for managing and processing meteorological information.- Design and implementation of REST APIs and Web Services for mobile app integration.- Design, maintenance, and evolution of the persistence layer on Oracle 11g, managing a model of more than 150 tables, sequences, constraints, audit triggers, and PL/SQL packages.- Diagnosis and resolution of incidents in loading and processing file tasks, identifying problems in both the application logic and the database layer.- Automation of report generation and distribution using Apache POI for Excel and Velocity for HTML email generation.- Development of unit tests using JUnit 4, Mockito 2, and PowerMock, contributing to code maintainability and reliability.- Analysis and monitoring of code quality through SonarQube.- Preparation and maintenance of technical documentation and architecture/design diagrams using Enterprise Architect.- Participation in the complete lifecycle of the application, from implementing new functionalities to integration, testing, and deployment.

Java - Spring - JavaScript - Oracle SQL Developer
